newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers under pressure on thin enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers under pressure on thin enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were stable on Monday but few enquiries could caused prices to fall later, traders said.

"The demand is not there. Shipowners will only cover minimum requirements," said one trader. Traders said Singapore's bunker prices are high compared with other ports in the region and are poised for a fall, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst was indicated at $97-$99 per tonne and 180-cst was at $102-$105. MDO and gas oil were at around Friday's levels at $190-$195 and $205-$215 respectively.
